groups.name: raf.datasource.datasources
groups.description: Named datasource configurations. Each key is a logical datasource name used with @DsSelector.

properties.name: raf.datasource.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable dynamic multi-datasource routing.

properties.name: raf.datasource.primary
properties.description: Name of the primary (default) datasource. Used when no @DsSelector annotation is present.

properties.name: raf.datasource.datasources
properties.description: Named datasource configurations. Key is the logical datasource name referenced by @DsSelector.

properties.name: raf.datasource.datasources[*].url
properties.description: JDBC URL for this datasource, e.g. jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/db?useSSL=false.

properties.name: raf.datasource.datasources[*].password
properties.description: Database password. Use Jasypt encryption for production.

properties.name: raf.datasource.datasources[*].driver-class-name
properties.description: Fully qualified JDBC driver class name, e.g. com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver.

properties.name: raf.datasource.datasources[*].max-wait
properties.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds when acquiring a connection from the pool.

properties.name: raf.datasource.datasources[*].slow-sql-millis
properties.description: Slow SQL threshold in milliseconds. Queries exceeding this value will be logged as warnings.
